description: What the user has PUBLISHED, newest first, with the sentence they described each change with, and which one visitors see right now. This is the list to use when someone says "wie letzte Woche" or "vor der Umgestaltung" — not runzero_list_versions, which lists every build including the platform's own bookkeeping commits and is unreadable for a person. Also reports whether something is built and waiting.
name: runzero_list_releases
title: List releases
